```sql
SELECT SUM(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)") / SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)")
FROM main.frpm f
JOIN main.schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND s."Charter" = 1
  AND s."OpenDate" <= DATE '2015-09-01';
```
